story.ascii: comb @closure[f: A -> A, g: A -> A](p: A) -> A = let found = rec bfs(index, discovered) = if eq(index, length(discovered)) then discovered else let first = f(at_perm(discovered, index)) in if is_perm(first) then let expanded = if contains(discovered, first) then discovered else append(discovered, first) in let second = g(at_perm(discovered, index)) in if is_perm(second) then let updated = if contains(expanded, second) then expanded else append(expanded, second) in let count = require_limit(length(updated)) in bfs(add(index, 1), updated) else reject("invalid") else reject("invalid") measure sub(4097, index) in bfs(0, append(sequence.items<>, p)) in rec check_images(index, first_images, second_images) = if eq(index, length(found)) then let count_first = length(sorted_unique(first_images)) in let count_second = length(sorted_unique(second_images)) in let valid_first = require_bijective(add(sub(count_first, length(found)), 1)) in let valid_second = require_bijective(add(sub(count_second, length(found)), 1)) in sorted_unique(found) else check_images(add(index, 1), append(first_images, f(at_perm(found, index))), append(second_images, g(at_perm(found, index)))) measure sub(length(found), index) in check_images(0, sequence.items<>, sequence.items<>) L1

story.ascii: obs ?center{s} = rec filter_center(index, result) = if eq(index, length(?cards{s})) then result else let candidate = at_seq(?cards{s}, index) in filter_center(add(index, 1), if rec commutes_with_all(other_index) = if eq(other_index, length(?cards{s})) then true else let other = at_seq(?cards{s}, other_index) in if rec positions_commute(position) = if eq(position, 12) then true else (if eq(at(candidate, sub(at(other, position), 1)), at(other, sub(at(candidate, position), 1))) then positions_commute(add(position, 1)) else false) measure sub(12, position) in positions_commute(0) then commutes_with_all(add(other_index, 1)) else false measure sub(length(?cards{s}), other_index) in commutes_with_all(0) then append(result, pack(candidate)) else result) measure sub(length(?cards{s}), index) in filter_center(0, sequence.items<>) L1
